import os, pty, termios, fcntl, struct, subprocess, select, time, tempfile, pathlib, json, re, unicodedata, signal, hashlib, platform, errno, ctypes
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
# This decoder is the previously independently checked file-analysis PTY decoder, including
# cursor movement/erase and wide-cell replacement. Its controlled overwrite oracle is retained.
parser = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/sweepx-file-analysis-pty.py').read_text().split('import hashlib, platform')[0]
exec(parser.split('def check(')[0])
binary = repo / 'target/debug/sweepx'
assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'f77b26e420710ca1bf882214f676ec4284471e49c29405172ccbf5b57edd8c80'
artifact_root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='sweepx-warm-pty-audit-', dir='/private/tmp'))
records=[]
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib',use_errno=True)
lib.proc_listchildpids.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
lib.proc_listchildpids.restype=ctypes.c_int
def children(pid):
    buffer=(ctypes.c_int*64)()
    count=lib.proc_listchildpids(pid,buffer,ctypes.sizeof(buffer))
    return list(buffer[:max(0,min(count,64))])
def hashes(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
def check(index, mode, locale):
    base = artifact_root / str(index); base.mkdir()
    root = base / 'projects'; root.mkdir(); state=base/'state'
    (root/'Cargo.toml').write_bytes(b'[workspace]\nmembers=[]\n')
    target=root/'target'; target.mkdir()
    (target/'payload').write_bytes(b'unchanged-pty-fixture')
    for n in range(8192): (target/('probe-%05d'%n)).write_bytes(b'01234567')
    originals=hashes(root)
    expected_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in target.iterdir())
    record={'case':index,'mode':mode,'locale':locale,'ordinaryTargetFiles':8193,'independentLogicalBytes':expected_bytes,'inputDigest':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(originals,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
    seed_cmd=[str(binary),'--locale',locale,'--state-dir',str(state),'--format','json','junk','--timings',str(root)]
    # Bounded deterministic fixture has one candidate; output is retained in files and verified
    # against a 2 MiB admission ceiling. Never dump arbitrary process output to the conversation.
    with (base/'seed.json').open('wb') as out, (base/'seed.stderr').open('wb') as err:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(seed_cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err,start_new_session=True)
        try: code=proc.wait(timeout=15)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL); proc.wait(timeout=3); record['seedTimedOut']=True; return record
    assert (base/'seed.json').stat().st_size <= 2*1048576
    assert (base/'seed.stderr').stat().st_size <= 2*1048576
    record['seedExitCode']=code
    seed=json.loads((base/'seed.json').read_text())
    assert code==0 and seed['status']=='ok' and len(seed['candidates'])==1
    row=seed['candidates'][0]
    assert row['path']==str(target) and row['ruleId']=='rust.target'
    if row['sizeIsLogical']: assert int(row['reclaimable']['value'])==expected_bytes
    record['seedFacts']={k:row[k] for k in ('ruleId','risk','reclaimable','sizeIsLogical')}
    record['seedTimings']=[json.loads(line) for line in (base/'seed.stderr').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
    assert list((state/'junk-cache').glob('*.json'))
    master,slave=pty.openpty(); fcntl.ioctl(slave,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack('HHHH',30,140,0,0)); before=termios.tcgetattr(slave)
    def child(): os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(0,termios.TIOCSCTTY,0)
    env=os.environ.copy(); env['TERM']='xterm-256color'
    command=[str(binary),'--locale',locale,'--state-dir',str(state),'junk','--tui',str(root)]
    wrapper='"$1" --locale "$2" --state-dir "$3" junk --tui "$4" <&0 & sx_child=$!; printf "\\nSX_TUI_PID:%s\\n" "$sx_child"; wait "$sx_child"; sx_code=$?; printf "\\nSX_TUI_EXIT:%s\\n" "$sx_code"; IFS= read -r continuation; exit "$sx_code"'
    proc=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sh','-c',wrapper,'sweepx-pty-wrapper',str(binary),locale,str(state),str(root)],stdin=slave,stdout=slave,stderr=slave,env=env,preexec_fn=child)
    started=time.monotonic(); output=bytearray(); sampler=None; view=''; complete=None; historical=None
    def drain(wait):
        if select.select([master],[],[],wait)[0]:
            try: chunk=os.read(master,65536)
            except OSError as e:
                if e.errno!=errno.EIO: raise
                return
            output.extend(chunk)
            assert len(output)<=2*1048576
    try:
        while time.monotonic()-started<10:
            drain(.02); view=screen(output)
            if historical is None and ('Historical/partial' in view or '历史/不完整' in view): historical=time.monotonic()-started
            if complete is None and ('Complete' if locale=='en-US' else '完成') in view.splitlines()[1] and 'rust.target' in view:
                complete=time.monotonic()-started; break
            if time.monotonic()-started>=8 and sampler is None and proc.poll() is None:
                marker=re.search(rb'SX_TUI_PID:(\d+)',output)
                pid=int(marker[1]) if marker else None
                if pid is not None and pid in children(proc.pid):
                    sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(pid),'1','1','-mayDie','-file',str(base/'sample.txt')],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
            if proc.poll() is not None: break
        record.update(historicalSeconds=historical,completeSeconds=complete,originalTenSecondCompletion=complete is not None,stackSampleRequested=sampler is not None,ownedWrapperPid=proc.pid)
        (base/'screen.txt').write_text(view)
        marker=re.search(rb'SX_TUI_PID:(\d+)',output)
        pid=int(marker[1]) if marker else None
        record['ownedTuiPid']=pid
        if proc.poll() is None:
            if mode=='sigterm':
                assert pid is not None and pid in children(proc.pid)
                os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            else: os.write(master,b'\x03' if mode=='ctrl-c' else b'q')
        exit_deadline=time.monotonic()+3
        while b'SX_TUI_EXIT:' not in output and proc.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<exit_deadline: drain(.02)
        marker=re.search(rb'SX_TUI_EXIT:(\d+)',output)
        if marker: record['exitCode']=int(marker[1])
        else: record['exitTimedOut']=True
        record['terminalAttributesRestored']=before==termios.tcgetattr(slave)
        record['alternateScreenRestored']=b'\x1b[?1049l' in output
        record['capturedBytes']=len(output); (base/'pty.bin').write_bytes(output)
        record['namesAndSHA256Unchanged']=originals==hashes(root)
        record['targetFileCountUnchanged']=len(list(target.iterdir()))==8193
        record['logicalBytesUnchanged']=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in target.iterdir())==expected_bytes
        record['expectedExitCode']={'quit':0,'ctrl-c':130,'sigterm':143}[mode]
        os.write(master,b'\n')
        exit_deadline=time.monotonic()+3
        while proc.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<exit_deadline: drain(.02)
        if proc.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL); proc.wait(timeout=3); record['wrapperExitTimedOut']=True
        else: record['wrapperExitCode']=proc.returncode
        record['allChecksPassed']=all((record['originalTenSecondCompletion'],historical is not None,record.get('exitCode')==record['expectedExitCode'],record.get('wrapperExitCode')==record['expectedExitCode'],record['terminalAttributesRestored'],record['alternateScreenRestored'],record['namesAndSHA256Unchanged'],record['targetFileCountUnchanged'],record['logicalBytesUnchanged']))
        return record
    finally:
        if proc.poll() is None: os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL); proc.wait(timeout=3)
        if sampler is not None:
            try: sampler.wait(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: sampler.kill(); sampler.wait(timeout=3)
            record['sampleExitCode']=sampler.returncode
            if (base/'sample.txt').exists(): record['sampleReport']=(base/'sample.txt').read_bytes()[:256*1024].decode(errors='replace')
        os.close(master); os.close(slave)

cases=[('quit','en-US')]*3+[('ctrl-c','en-US'),('sigterm','en-US'),('quit','zh-CN')]
for i,(mode,locale) in enumerate(cases):
    record=check(i,mode,locale); records.append(record); print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('seedFacts','seedTimings','sampleReport')}),flush=True)
